adapter.description: Harness-binding files that legitimately differ between the OpenClaw install and the Claude Code (claude-nine) install: engine defaults (Amendment 5B), runner profiles, the generation route text, and SKILL.md (whose onboarding copy carries a gate section the 999 copy must not carry). Parity requires the file to exist in both repos and reports the diff; it never requires byte identity. scripts/write_intake.py is adapter-class for one recorded delta: the 999 copy records runtime claude-nine by default and refuses image_engine agnes in writing when no Agnes key is configured (Item 28 Row 5).

changelog.description: CHANGELOG.md is regenerated per repo by each repo's own release process; parity reports it and never compares bytes.

generated.description: Files the sync generates into 999 from onboarding sources. Parity recomputes the payload from the onboarding sources and fails on any difference beyond the generation stamp.

neutral.description: Default class. Files must be byte-identical in both repos. Anything not listed in another class is neutral.

nine_only.description: Files that exist only in the 999 edition: the vendored fallback and route modules (Item 28 Rows 2, 5, 7) and the generated policy data (Row 3). Parity requires each to be present in 999 and does not look for an onboarding counterpart.

onb_only.description: Files that must never cross into the 999 repo. two_strike_adapter.py is an onboarding-only guard module; the 999 copy of the skill must not contain it.

version.description: Repo-regenerated version files. Each repo carries its own; parity requires the MAJOR versions to match and refuses (as the sync does) when they do not.

ghl_pack.description: The GHL pack (Skills 6, 44, and 38's conversational layer) is classified per file by its own manifest in this folder: neutral files byte-parity, adapter files version-tracked by seam, excluded Skill 38 files must be absent in 999.

purpose: Classification of every file in the Skill 71 tree for the onboarding to 999 sync and parity check (fix plan Item 27). Sync direction is onboarding to 999, always. Any file not matched by a class below is neutral by the default rule, and the parity checker FAILS on any drift it cannot classify under the rules stated here.

tracked_repo_files.description: Item 28 Row 1: the vendored enforcer. ONB repo root shared-utils/ against 999 repo root shared-utils/.

The frontmatter-version guard. 999 gains the equivalent of the onboarding repo's guard as a tracked copy at its own repo-root scripts/ (it scans any root for skill-version.txt files, so the same file serves the .claude/skills layout).
